units.source_text: 我把视线从名人的遗容移到他的胸部，只见他像一具木偶，裹着带六角形图案的粗布衣裳，露出一个脑袋。

en.t: I moved my gaze from the Master's dead face to his chest and saw him lying like a puppet, wrapped in a coarse robe with a hexagonal pattern, with only his head showing.

units.source_text: 这件大岛产的六角形图案衣裳是在名人身后由家里人给换上的，很不合体，肩膀处鼓鼓囊囊的。

en.t: This Oshima-made robe with its hexagonal pattern had been put on him by his family after his death; it did not fit at all, and it bulged loosely around the shoulders.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我总感到名人的尸体仿佛没有了下半截身子似的。

en.t: Even so, I could not shake the feeling that the Master's body seemed to have lost its lower half.

units.source_text: “看来到了最后，他已经完全没有挪动身体的力气了。”

en.t: It seems that by the end he no longer had any strength at all to move his body.

units.source_text: 这是在箱根，医生形容的名人腰腿的情况。

en.t: That was how the doctor in Hakone described the condition of the Master's hips and legs.

units.source_text: 人们将名人的遗体从鳞屋旅馆搬上汽车时，名人头部以下的躯体好像也没有了。

en.t: When they carried the Master's remains from the Urokoya Inn into the car, it was as though the body below his head had vanished too.

units.source_text: 我作为观战记者，最初看到的是坐着的名人那单薄的小小的膝盖。

en.t: As the match reporter, the first thing I saw was the Master's thin, small knees as he sat there.

units.source_text: 遗像也只是照了脸部，好像那里只有一个头，令人望而生畏。

en.t: The memorial photograph showed only his face, as if there were nothing there but a single head, and it filled one with awe and fear.

units.source_text: 看上去，这张照片也像非现实的东西。

en.t: To look at it, the photograph too seemed like something unreal.

units.source_text: 在这张照片上留下的，也许是一张由于一心扑在棋艺上而丧失了许多现实的东西、最后落得悲剧下场的人的脸，

en.t: What remained in that photograph may have been the face of a man who, by devoting himself entirely to the art of Go, had lost much of reality and in the end met a tragic fate,

units.source_text: 也许是一张殉身于命运的人的脸。

en.t: or perhaps it was the face of a man who had given his life to destiny.

units.source_text: 正如秀哉名人的棋艺以这盘告别棋而告终一样，他的生命也宣告结束了。

en.t: Just as Master Shusai's art of Go came to an end with this farewell game, his life too announced its close.
